name: 中尊寺金色堂
checkpoints: A small single-storey square hall with THREE front bays, a single hogyo pyramidal wooden-tile roof and jewel finial; curved eaves, no upper storey.
Round columns and simple bracket blocks, a surrounding low timber veranda; three paired doors open outward, only lightly suggest the altar without dark fills.
Exclude all modern shelter walls, rafters, glass, lighting and modern walkway visible around the golden building; do not draw the shelter as part of the monument.
